mapper.insert: INSERT INTO minio_object_outbox (upload_operation_id, bucket, object_key, action, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, lease_until, last_error, course_id) VALUES (#{uploadOperationId}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{action}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{leaseUntil}, #{lastError}, #{courseId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, upload_operation_id AS uploadOperationId, bucket, object_key AS objectKey, action, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, lease_until AS leaseUntil, last_error AS lastError, course_id AS courseId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM minio_object_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE minio_object_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
